chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ali ibn Asbat, from some of our companions, said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade discipline at the time of anger.

key_terms.الْغَضَبِ: anger; a state of emotional agitation
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about disciplining someone while angry?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that corrective discipline should not be carried out while one is in a state of anger. It highlights restraint, self-control, and avoiding action when emotion may lead to excess or injustice.
